newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-Danish 96 public deficit at 14.9 bln Dkk.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Danish 96 public deficit at 14.9 bln Dkk.

text.p: Denmark's Economy Ministry said on Monday that it expected the public sector budget deficit for 1996 to be 14.9 billion crowns, falling to 3.5 billion crowns in 1997.
The deficit in 1995 was 15.9 billion crowns.

The figures in the ministry's latest economic survey, compared with a forecast for 1996 of a 15.3 billion crown public sector budget shortfall, falling to 5.8 billion crowns in 1997 in its last survey in August. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
